headline.text: Where should Cambridge focus small-business support in September 2025?

findings.text: Central Square has 15 vacant storefronts in the latest snapshot and the highest count-duration priority score.
findings.method: Latest snapshot; districts ranked by storefront count × estimated average vacancy months.

findings.text: Among 96 storefronts with a reported vacancy year, 79 (82.3%) are estimated to have been vacant for more than 12 months.
findings.method: Latest snapshot; July assumed when only a vacancy year is supplied.

findings.text: The public permit file contains 15 cottage-food permits; the median recorded submit-to-issue interval is 26 days.
findings.method: Difference between issue_date and applicant_submit_date; personal fields excluded by server-side projection.

recommendations.text: Concentrate the first outreach cycle in Central Square and Harvard Square instead of distributing effort evenly.
recommendations.action: Assign a district lead, contact property stakeholders through internal channels, and review progress after 90 days.

recommendations.text: Pilot a small-space matching program for the 13 observed storefronts under 1,500 sqft that are estimated vacant for more than a year.
recommendations.action: Package permitting guidance and fit-out support around smaller, lower-capital spaces.

recommendations.text: Create an opt-in pathway for permitted cottage-food operators who want to test a shared commercial kitchen or storefront.
recommendations.action: Invite operators through the City’s own secure records; do not publish or reuse personal contact details.
